title: Chudleigh's Farm
specs: Scenic tractor wagon rides by the Niagara Escarpment
Children’s play area with four huge slides, tower, and hay maze
Apple picking with multiple varieties during fall season
Admission ticket required, purchased online in advance; no walk-ins
Support worker admitted with person with disability; Access 2 Card discount available
Dogs allowed on leash except in restaurant, animal area, and tractor ride
Groups of 100+ can purchase tickets and will be contacted by staff to assist with event details
includes: Access to orchard, children’s entertainment area, and market
Tractor wagon ride around the orchard
Access to farm animal area and nature trail
blurb: Guests purchase timed admission tickets online to visit the farm, which includes access to the orchard, children's entertainment area, and market. Activities include scenic tractor wagon rides, apple picking, farm animal area, nature trail, play area with slides and hay maze, and seasonal events like Summer Music Nights. The farm operates rain or shine and does not allow outside food or drinks on the premises.
extraNote: All ticket sales are final; no refunds or transfers · Farm operates rain or shine; no rain checks or passes · Tickets must be used within the booked time slot; early or late arrivals not accommodated · Cash not accepted; contactless payments preferred · Outside food, drinks, cakes, decorations, and outside vendors not permitted
